locations.title: Cursed Flame
locations.description:
**Location:** Available at the start of the game

**Spell:** Throws a cursed fireball that deals damage on contact

**Works of Mercy:**
- Hit 20 times with this spell

**Blessings:**
- Fires a bigger fireball that slightly pushes back its target

locations.title: Holy Cross
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [The Fallen](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=959152)

**Spell:** Throws a corrupted cross that deals damage to enemies it hits. Returns to Rose after traveling a certain distance or hitting a wall

**Works of Mercy:**
- Find 3 different whip-type weapons
- Kill 5 enemies with the same cross(not neceesseralit at the same time)
- Kill 10 enemies with a whip attack

**Blessings:**
- You can throw a **SECOND** cross
- The cross inflicts more damage the farther away it is from Rose
- Catching the returning cross lets Rose regain 10% of the spell's mana cost for each time an enemy was hit, up to a maximum of 60%

locations.title: Infernal Pyre
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [The Warrior - Joan of Arc](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=959327)

**Spell:** Unleashes flames on the ground around Rose, igniting and launching enemies into the air

**Works of Mercy:**
- Successfully parry 15 attacks with the Holy Light
- Reach a sacred place so Joan can pray - ||[Notre-Dame Painting](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=975370)||
- Set 5 enemies on fire at the same time

**Blessings:**
- Regain 25% of the spell's mana cost for each enemy hit by the central explosion, starting with the second enemy
- Enemies hit by Joan's spell are thrown high in the air
- Hitting an enemy with a weapon prolongs the fire on them

locations.title: Petrifying Gaze
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Medusa](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=960112)

**Spell:** Petrify enemies in front of Rose

**Works of Mercy:**
- Petrify an enemy carrying a shield with Medusa's Spell
- Kill 25 enemies from fall damage directly after petrifying them in the air

**Blessings:**
- Killing a petrified enemy restores a quantity of mana equivalent to Half the cost of Medusa's spell
- The closer the targets affected by this spell are to Rose, the longer they remain petrified, and the more hits it takes to break the petrification

locations.title: Blood Spikes
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Carmilla](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=995698)

**Spell:** Summons blood spikes to impale nearby enemies, dealing low damage and causing them to bleed. Always targets the furthest enemy on the platform

**Works of Mercy:**
- Kill 25 enemies from bleed-effect damage
- Find 2 different dual blade-type weapons
- Cause an enemy to bleed continuously for 10 seconds

**Blessings:**
- Applying the bleeding effect to an already bleeding enemy deals instant damage to it
- Heals Rose 2% of her max health every time an enemy dies from bleeding
- Bleeding enemies are slower and deal 25% less damage to Rose

locations.title: Fist of Talos
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [The Builder - Talos](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=1011729)

**Spell:** A huge fist strikes the ground, dealing massive damage to enemies directly below, with much less damage to targets further away. Also triggers a small earthquake that shakes enemies in a wide radius, potentially knocking them off their platforms.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Kill 3 enemies with one fist
- Kill 10 airbone enemy with a fist as it falls down
- Kill 15 enemies with the smash

**Blessings:**

locations.title: Masterpiece
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [The Artist - Brauner](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=975406)

**Spell:** Summons a gargoyle from a large slab of rock. The gargoyle floats near Rose and shoots fireballs at nearby enemies. Recasting this spell while the gargoyle is still alive, makes it slam vertically upon a nearby enemy and explode, dealing extra damage.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Kill 30 enemies with the Gargoyle Dive
- Cause 5 enemies to fall to their death with the Gargoyle Summoning Stone
- Find all the secret zones in the Main Hall


**Blessings:**
- Summons an additional Gargoyle
- Rose heals every time the Gargoyle's fire ball hits an enemy
- Killing at least one enemy with the Gargoyle Dive prevents the Gargoyle's destruction

locations.title: Soul Harvest
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Death](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=1011871) in Notre-Dame

**Spell:** Unleashes a slow but devastating scythe attack. Any enemy killed this way creates 4 sickles that are thrown around.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Complete the [hidden puzzle](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=1041467) in Notre Dame
- Kill 44 skeletons (of any sort)
- Kill 4 enemies with the same cast of Death's spell


**Blessings:**
- If this spell only hits one enemy, Rose heals 4% of her maximum health
- If a sickle kills an enemy, it splits into 4 new sickles
- Each sickle that hits an enemy restores 25% of the spell's mana cost

locations.title: Chronomantic Dive
locations.description:

**Spell:** Rose jumps in the air, then falls down to the ground, dealing damage on the way and creating a cross of green fire, damaging
enemies on its path while also slowing down time for a brief moment.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Kill 20 enemies while in slow motion
- Explore all rooms of Clock Tower


**Blessings:**
- The time slow effect is longer
- Creates a bigger explosion if Rose dives from a high enough position

locations.title: Life Drain

**Spell:** Hold the spell button to cast a life drain in front of Rose. It latches onto the nearest enemy and deals damage. This spell also heals Rose every time it deals damage to its target.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Drain an enemy for 5 seconds straight without interruption
- Explore all rooms of Hall of Mirrors
- Kill 25 enemies with the life drain


**Blessings:**
- The drain deals bonus damage if Rose is at FULL health when it ticks
- Getting hit while holding this spell doesn't interrupt it

locations.title: Mirror Walk
locations.description:

**Spell:** Places a mirror at Rose's current location. When recast, Rose teleports to the mirror's location and regains 5o% of the health points she lost since casting the spell. The mirror disappears after 15 seconds or when Rose teleports to it.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Use 34 Save Rooms
- Heal 1000 of health with this spell
- Kill 5 enemies within 3 seconds of dodging their attacks with teleportation

**Blessings:**
- If Rose uses teleportation without losing life since the mirror is placed, she regains 80% of the consumed mana.
- Rose deals significant damage to enemies in the path of the teleportation.
- Receiving a fatal blow while a mirror is active prevents death and activates teleportation. Can only be activated once but can be recharged when Rose interacts with a Save room.

locations.title: Wheel of Chaos
locations.description:

**Spell:** Launches a wheel bearing the Eye of Mammon, targeting the nearest enemy (in any direction). The projectile then hovers in place for a few seconds, during which time the spell can be recast for a reduced mana cost. In this case, the wheel spins out and attacks the nearest enemy again.

**Works of Mercy:**
- Have the wheel spin for 15 seconds without interruption
- Kill 5 different enemies with one wheel
- Spend 1000 mana points on recasts of this spell

**Blessings:**
- This spell can be cast using health if Rose does not have enough mana and will deal 50% more damage

**Blessings:**

**Blessings:**

**Blessings:**
